posts.title: Re: Time to Troll
posts.html:
Jdog, I'm going to tell you something. I've worked as a man of comedy/roasting on several occasions. Everyone knows about the phone calls I do, and the damage I inflict on crappy businesses that really deserve to be shat on, but I don't see the comedy in this. I don't think what you're doing now is funny not because I feel bad about the kid, but rather the fact that the kid is an easy target. Like a wheelchair bound midget, this kid is pretty much a fish out of water when it comes to comedy practices.

If I could pick any person in the world to roast, it'd be someone that's rich and has a successful life. The thing your doing is not even a roast though, it's something even less funny. You're going to act like a Van Gotti, manipulate this guy into giving you his email, and then posting it here where you want us to "do what ever we want" to him? Seriously, I think someone that doesn't have a life would email fruitless shit to a stranger.

Okay, he'll get spammed email. Then what? It's not like you're going to see his reaction or anything. It'd probably take you more effort to write to the kid than it does for him to delete it.

This is just my opinion, but I'm at least most of us agree that we have lives. Hell, I'm working for nothing, writing for newspapers and magazines, and filing taxes. I have no time to fuck around on the internet these days.
